name: Real Sound: Echoing Sky
source:
A mysterious crash, the sudden disappearance of a village, a deserted island hosting the first artificial ecosystem...the mysteries of New Ascension Island keep piling up as a young undercover exorcist is sent by the Church to investigate what's really happening on the island.

[From [url=https://wandeer.itch.io/real-sound-echoing-sky]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场神秘的坠机事件、一个村庄的突然消失、一座拥有第一个人工生态系统的荒岛……新阿森松岛的谜团不断堆积，一名年轻的卧底驱魔师被教会派去调查岛上到底发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://wandeer.itch.io/real-sound-echoing-sky]itch.io[/url]]
